strings.zh: 我是研究密码学的专家。{NEWLINE}最近学界比较流行一种{CLEAR}叫摩斯密码的加密方式,{CLEAR}就是用 . 和 - 来代表字母。{CLEAR}比如说a是 . -{CLEAR}b是 - . . .{CLEAR}d是 - . .{CLEAR}e是 .{CLEAR}g是 - - .{CLEAR}l是 . - . .{CLEAR}o是 - - -{CLEAR}p是 . - - .{CLEAR}r是 . - .{CLEAR}u是 . . -{CLEAR}y是 - . - -{SCROLL}只用 . 和 - 就可以表达全部的字母,{NEWLINE}排列组合还真是个神奇的东西。
strings.en: I’m an expert in cryptography.{NEWLINE}Lately, a cipher called Morse code has{CLEAR}become popular among scholars.{CLEAR}It uses . and - to stand for letters.{CLEAR}For example, A is . -{CLEAR}B is - . . .{CLEAR}D is - . .{CLEAR}E is .{CLEAR}G is - - .{CLEAR}L is . - . .{CLEAR}O is - - -{CLEAR}P is . - - .{CLEAR}R is . - .{CLEAR}U is . . -{CLEAR}Y is - . - -{SCROLL}Just . and - can spell out every letter.{NEWLINE}Combinations really are amazing.
strings.notes: Morse hints for the colour-word puzzle in 0316 (RED/GRE/YEL/BLU/ORA/PUR); letters kept as capitals, codes verbatim.

strings.zh: 原来我以为很多口袋妖怪{NEWLINE}都可以掌握剧毒这个技能,{CLEAR}但是根据大木博士的最新报告,{CLEAR}能够掌握剧毒这项技能的精灵{CLEAR}远比想象中要少。
strings.en: I used to think lots of Pokémon could{NEWLINE}learn the move Toxic.{SCROLL}But according to Professor Oak’s{NEWLINE}latest report, far fewer Pokémon can{CLEAR}learn Toxic than you’d expect.

strings.zh: 这个城镇的游戏中心原本是由{NEWLINE}火箭队经营的。{SCROLL}其实,游戏本身并没什么坏处,{NEWLINE}不好的是以公平游戏为名来骗钱,{CLEAR}更不好的是用骗来的钱干坏事！
strings.en: This town’s Game Corner used to be run{NEWLINE}by Team Rocket.{SCROLL}Games themselves aren’t bad. What’s{NEWLINE}bad is cheating people out of money in{CLEAR}the name of fair games.{SCROLL}And worse still is using that money to{NEWLINE}do evil!

strings.zh: 多亏了吉尔露太先生,{NEWLINE}彩虹市才能有这么好玩的游戏厅！
strings.en: It’s all thanks to Mr. Lawrence that{NEWLINE}Celadon has such a fun Game Corner!

strings.zh: 这里的人也说没有见过臭臭花,{NEWLINE}它到底在哪呢……
strings.en: The people here haven’t seen Gloom{NEWLINE}either. Where could it be...?

strings.zh: 对付莉佳的草系精灵,{NEWLINE}冰系技能是个很好的选择。{CLEAR}如果你能给我1个朋友球,{CLEAR}我就把冰冻拳教给你的精灵。{SCROLL}怎么样,要学吗？
strings.en: Against Erika’s Grass-type Pokémon,{NEWLINE}Ice-type moves are a great choice.{SCROLL}If you give me one Friend Ball, I’ll{NEWLINE}teach your Pokémon Ice Punch.{SCROLL}How about it? Want to learn it?
Snover: Snooo-ver!
strings.notes: zh cry ‘MSnooo——ver’ has a stray M; dropped.

strings.zh: 你并没有朋友球啊,{NEWLINE}等有球了再来找我吧。
strings.en: You don’t have a Friend Ball. Come back{NEWLINE}when you’ve got one.
